## Description and Rationale

We are a team of data professionals and software developers from USTH, brought together by a shared passion for aviation. Although life guided us into programming and data science, our childhood dreams of becoming pilots or air traffic controllers (ATC) never faded.We registered for the PRC Data Challenge 2026 as a meaningful way to bridge our daily technical skills with our lifelong passion for the skies. Along with like-minded peers, we aim to leverage data science to solve real-world aviation challenges, learn from the global community, and stay connected to the domain we love.
